name: shield_dome
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mobile game enemy shield effect (battle VFX)
Subject: a protective force-field bubble seen from the SIDE, like a snow globe made of frosted glass: a perfect sphere whose WHOLE interior is filled with one smooth, soft, uniform pale frosted glass tint (a light steel-white with a hint of silver, a gentle gradient that is slightly lighter at the upper left and a little deeper near the edge), absolutely no blotches, no noise, no speckles, no holes, no empty areas inside. Over the glass a regular honeycomb of thin hexagonal panes: crisp thin bright white seams with a small bright node dot at each hexagon corner, the hexagons getting smaller toward the edge to follow the curve of the sphere. A bright crisp rim highlight runs along the whole outer edge, thicker at the bottom, plus a soft glow at the very edge. A curved white specular glint at the upper left. Colour is almost neutral (silver-white and pale steel) so a game can tint it.
Style: hand-painted 2D game VFX sprite for a polished mobile game: glassy, clean, crisp hex lines, rich rim light, NO dark outline, NO white sticker border, NO drop shadow.
Composition: perfectly round, centred, filling about 92 percent of the image, nothing else in the picture.
Background: genuinely transparent background (alpha) outside the sphere. No checkerboard pattern.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no watermark, nothing cropped.

name: sheet_bolts
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mobile game lightning sprite sheet (battle VFX)
Subject: SIX separate lightning strikes laid out in a strict grid of 2 columns by 3 rows, one strike centred in each cell. Each is a single jagged horizontal bolt running from the far LEFT of its cell to the far RIGHT of its cell with sharp zig-zag kinks, two or three short thin side branches, tapering to a point at both ends: a white-hot core, a bright electric yellow-white inner edge, then a saturated electric cyan-blue glow with a violet outer aura. All six have different zig-zag shapes. No clouds, no ground.
Style: hand-painted 2D game VFX sprites for a polished mobile game: crisp bright core, soft glow, NO dark outline, NO white sticker border.
Composition: each bolt fully inside its own cell, spanning most of the cell's width, generous empty space above and below, nothing touching another bolt or the image edge.
Background: genuinely transparent background (alpha). No checkerboard pattern, no frame, no grid lines.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no watermark, nothing cropped.

name: sheet_foe_rings
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: mobile game hostile aura ground rings (battle VFX)
Subject: TWO separate circular ground rings seen from straight above, laid out side by side in a strict grid of 2 columns by 1 row, one ring centred in each cell, each ring a thin band with a completely empty, transparent centre (the inside of the ring is see-through, only the band is drawn), the band about 12 percent of the ring's diameter:
1. a speed-up warning ring: a dark charcoal band with a row of bright orange-yellow chevron arrows (like >>> speed marks) all pointing clockwise around the whole circle, thin bright orange rim lines on both edges of the band, a hot orange-red glow, motion streaks trailing behind each chevron.
2. a healing-support ring: a deep crimson-red band with a row of white plus-sign crosses evenly spaced around the whole circle, thin bright pink-white rim lines on both edges, a soft red-pink glow and a few tiny rising white plus signs.
Both read as dangerous enemy abilities, not friendly: hard, warning-sign look.
Style: hand-painted 2D game VFX sprites for a polished mobile game: bold readable shapes, rich saturated colour, crisp edges, soft outer glow, NO dark outline, NO white sticker border.
Composition: each ring perfectly circular, filling about 90 percent of its cell, nothing touching the other ring or the image edge.
Background: genuinely transparent background (alpha). No checkerboard pattern, no frame, no grid lines.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no watermark, nothing cropped.
